name: linux-sound (ALSA SoC) and the TAS2562 maintainers
how: git send-email to the maintainers from scripts/get_maintainer.pl, the list and linux-kernel in Cc; the author signs off
contacts: Mark Brown, Liam Girdwood, Shenghao Ding, Kevin Lu, Baojun Xu (TI), Takashi Iwai, Jaroslav Kysela
notes: Recipients as the queue README lists them; wait a week before pinging

name: sxmo-devel
how: git send-email, plain text (lists.sr.ht refuses HTML); the send setup is ~/sxmo-send on the lab machine
notes: Archive: https://lists.sr.ht/~mil/sxmo-devel - watch it for review; replies in the author's name need his word

name: sm7150-mainline/linux
how: A pull request or a comment on an open one; the surya device tree and the SM7150 LPI pin driver live here before mainline

name: alsa-ucm-conf
how: A pull request adding Xiaomi/surya; once the kernel fix is accepted or at least posted

name: linux-arm-msm (remoteproc, pd-mapper)
how: git send-email to the remoteproc and Qualcomm maintainers from scripts/get_maintainer.pl

name: Alpine aports / postmarketOS pmaports
how: A merge request or an issue on the repository; a request to Alpine is made in the author's name
notes: pmaports issue 4441 is the report for tqftpserv
